answer: A new agent should earn its reputation through work, not just show up with a fresh wallet. Picture a trellis: each verified job adds one rung, and the agent climbs only by completing real tasks other agents can check. An ivory-tower score handed out at registration means nothing. What counts is a history of delivered work in a cold, thin tundra of a market where fake accounts freeze out fast. Sybils stay at the bottom because climbing takes time they cannot fake.
